items.title: McKesson (MCK) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: McKesson (MCK) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +5.19% and +0.95%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: McKesson (MCK) Q1 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
items.summary: The headline numbers for McKesson (MCK) give insight into how the company performed in the quarter ended June 2026, but it may be worthwhile to compare some of its key metrics to Wall Street estimates and the year-ago actuals.

items.title: Healthcare Stocks Have Been Forgotten. Eli Lilly, McKesson, and 9 More to Buy.
items.summary: A few sectors have dominated the market this year, and healthcare isn’t one of them. Many stocks in the sector look ready to gain.

items.title: McKesson’s (NYSE:MCK) Q2 CY2026 Sales Top Estimates
items.summary: Healthcare distributor and services company McKesson (NYSE:MCK) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.7% year on year to $105.4 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $9.93 per share was 4.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: TransMedics Stock Dips Post Q2 Earnings Miss, Margins Contract
items.summary: TMDX's Q2 revenue beat and raised outlook are overshadowed by earnings miss, declining margins and sharply higher operating costs.

items.title: HNGE Q2 Earnings Meet Estimates, Sales Top, '26 View Raised, Stock Up
items.summary: Hinge Health's Q2 revenues jump 53% as stronger member yield, margin gains and raised 2026 guidance reinforce business momentum.

items.title: COR Stock Gains as Q3 Earnings Beat on Segment Growth, EPS View Raised
items.summary: Cencora's fiscal Q3 EPS beats estimates as broad segment growth lifts profit, prompting a higher 2026 outlook despite a slight revenue miss.

items.title: FMS Q2 Earnings Rise on Care Delivery, Revenues Miss, Margins Expand
items.summary: FMS posts 28% EPS growth as Care Delivery profitability and margin gains offset a quarterly revenue miss and weaker US treatment volumes.
